TQ2-6.note: The official v2.9.1 chapter 4 (V291_CH04_Orders_2024SEP.pdf, HL7 Attribute Table – TQ2) and hl7.eu hl7v291segmTQ2.htm print the Length of TQ2-6 Sequence Condition Code as "2.." (a minimum of 2, no maximum). The ledger reads the largest number in the column, 2; the length is the maximum, and with none printed the spec keeps 0 (no maximum), as v2.9. Caristix answers HTTP 500 for 2.9.1 and HAPI has no v2.9.1 module.
